Ava Chen: Quick heads-up — all-hands this Friday at 10am PT. Please block the time. :calendar:
Marcus Li: Agenda in the thread — product sprint kickoff, Dedicated rollout update, SRE incident summary, Q&A. 30–45m total.
Priya Nair: Remote-friendly — Zoom link in the calendar invite. Recording will be posted immediately after. If you can't make it, drop questions in this thread or use the form.
Sam Torres: Can we include a 5 min demo of the new autoscaler?
Marcus Li: Yep, Sam will do a short demo (~5m) right after the sprint goals.
Ava Chen: Also will share a brief note on company priorities for the quarter and hiring updates.
Priya Nair: Reminder: submit questions by Thursday 5pm if you'd like them read live. Google form: https://forms.gle/example-qna (placeholder)
RJ Bot: Deploy status: dedicated-capacity rollout to eu-west completed at 2024-11-08T03:12Z. :white_check_mark:
Sam Torres: A heads-up — SRE will present the Nov 2 caching incident postmortem (5m) — root cause + mitigations.
Marcus Li: For people who want deeper detail, we'll link the full postmortem doc in the follow-up. Short takeaways in the meeting.
Ava Chen: If anyone has a budget question, tag Finance in this thread — Marcus will surface top asks.
Priya Nair: Logistics: please keep mic muted unless speaking. Slack will be open for emoji reactions and follow-ups.
Marcus Li: Draft agenda (final):
- 10:00 intro (Ava) 3m
- 10:03 Q3 product sprint goals (Marcus) 10m
- 10:13 Autoscaler demo (Sam) 5m
- 10:18 Dedicated rollout & region update (infra) 7m
- 10:25 SRE incident summary (Sam) 5m
- 10:30 Company priorities + hiring update (Ava) 7m
- 10:37 Live Q&A + wrap (All) 8m
Marcus Li: If you'd like to add a 1–2 slide item, ping me before EOD Thursday.
Sam Torres: Will post the demo notes and a short snippet of the CLI commands in this thread before the meeting for folks who want to follow along.
Ava Chen: Recording and notes will be in the #all-hands channel and the handbook page after — expect a short TL;DR with action items.
Priya Nair: Post-meeting action: People Ops will follow up with new parental leave policy summary and the internal mobility update.
Marcus Li: Accessibility: we'll enable captions on Zoom and post a text transcript.
Ava Chen: Thanks everyone — see you Friday. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can attend.
Sam Torres: :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: :thumbsup:
RJ Bot: Reminder scheduled: 1770009300 (15m before meeting).
